summary: Frontend testing completed successfully. All reported bugs have been fixed: 1) Navbar search bar now works correctly - navigates to products page with search parameter, 2) Machine brand and model dropdowns are populated from DB and working, 3) Category pages (Rubber Tracks, Sprockets, Rollers, Idlers) show correct data counts, 4) Track size cards display proper Width/Pitch/Links values with no NaN issues.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend features tested and working: navbar search, home page search, category navigation (Rubber Tracks: 381, Sprockets: 20, Rollers: 35, Idlers: 21), brand/model dropdowns (52 brands, 162 Bobcat models), compatibility chart with width tabs and proper Width/Pitch/Links values, track size search showing compatible machines.

navbar_search.details: Search icon click opens input, typing 'CAT 259D' and pressing Enter navigates to /products?search=CAT%20259D, shows 1 compatible track size (320x86x53) and 2 compatible machines (CAT 259D, CAT 259D3)

home_page_search.details: Typing 'bobcat t190' and clicking Search navigates to products page, shows 3 compatible track sizes (13x4x56, 320x86x49, 400x86x49) and 2 compatible machines (Bobcat T190, Bobcat T190H)

category_rubber_tracks.details: Shows 'Compatible Rubber Track Sizes (381)' with proper Width/Pitch/Links values (e.g., 108x72x37 shows Width: 108mm | Pitch: 72mm | Links: 37)

brand_dropdown.details: Populated with 52 brands from DB (ASV, Airman, Bobcat, CAT, etc.)

model_dropdown.details: Selecting Bobcat populates 162 model options (220, 316, T190, etc.)

compatibility_chart.details: Shows width tabs (13mm, 15mm, 108mm, 130mm, 150mm, etc.), track size cards with proper Width/Pitch/Links values, no NaN values found

track_size_search.details: Searching '320x86x52' shows 1 compatible track size with proper dimensions and 42 compatible machines (Bobcat 864, S150, S160, S175, etc.)

chart_machine_search.details: Searching 'SVL75' in compatibility chart shows 3 matching machines (Kubota SVL 75, SVL 75-2) with compatible track sizes (320x86x52, 380x86x52, 400x86x52)
